name: Solar Flare (Varyag's Forge)
body:
School evocation [light]; Level arcanist 2, cleric 1, druid 2, hunter 2, inquisitor 1, oracle 1, shaman 2, sorcerer 2, paladin 1, wizard 2, warpriest 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell flashes a burst of intense light into the target’s eyes. The target is blinded for 1 round and dazzled for 1 round per caster level unless it makes a successful Fortitude save, which negates the blinded condition and reduces the dazzled condition to 1 round. Sightless creatures are not affected by solar flare.

Creatures with light sensitivity are blinded for 1 round per caster level if they fail the saving throw instead, and creatures with light blindness are blinded for 1 minute per caster level. In both cases, a successful save reduces this time to 1 round.
